VBO:0201464.summary: Tarsus çatalburuns are intelligent hunting dogs valued for quiet, close tracking. They follow scent carried by air and along the ground. Maço and Çapkın, two dogs trained for narcotics detection, met their training centre’s standards for cooperation with a handler. The breed has long been raised around Tarsus in southern Turkey.
VBO:0201464.shortDescription: Quiet and intelligent while tracking, Tarsus çatalburuns have a local hunting heritage and have also trained for scent detection.
